name: Flow canvas — owner's Neo Agent run 'Quant System PRD' (agent plan projection)

primaryActions.label: step node toolbar: Rerun · Edit · Delete

observations.text: A Neo Agent run is rendered entirely as canvas nodes: the user prompt (Chinese PRD brief, 'Me · 25-12-10') → a small step-label node (subtask text) → a 'Group 1' container holding six parallel research-result nodes → a vertical chain of ten step-label nodes each followed by its output document node (h1/h2 docs with version numbers 1.0.0 / 2.1.0) → a Sandbox Preview node ('Explore interactive code preview from flo.fun') → final spec nodes. Badge 'Powered by Neo'.

Step-label texts (the plan, in execution order): Conduct comprehensive research on multi-source market data integrations… | Generate a detailed database schema for Supabase using PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB… | Design the information ingestion system… RSS feeds… | Outline the AI/ML layer… Deepseek V3.2… | Design the trading system using C#/.NET 8… | Define the full GraphQL schema for the API Gateway (BFF)… | Prototype the Next.js 16.0.7 frontend powered by React 19… | Outline the DevOps and infrastructure configuration… | Synthesize all platform components into a unified monorepo structure… | Compile a final comprehensive system specification as an interactive webpage…
There is no separate plan panel, timeline or task list in the flow; the plan is the sequence of step nodes and the group of parallel branches. Selecting a step node gives Rerun · Edit · Delete.
Group nodes exist (editable name 'Edit group name') and visually contain their children.

Parallel subtasks are expressed as a Group of sibling nodes (fan-out), sequential subtasks as a chain; the agent chooses per step. Output documents carry version strings, suggesting the agent revised specs across steps (I1).
'Sandbox Preview' is a lazy-loaded embedded runtime (flo.fun) for the generated website — the Website mode's artifact type.
Whether the plan was shown for approval before execution; live streaming layout; how a run in progress looks (this run is complete).
